beats.text: In Madagascar, 80.2 percent of women work. In Yemen, that number is just 3.2 percent.
Employment to population ratio is the proportion of a country's population that is employed.
In the United States, 54 percent of women are employed. In China, that is 56.8 percent.
The top countries for women in the workforce: Madagascar at 80.2, Burundi at 78.9, and Tanzania at 78.5.
Madagascar has 25 times the female employment rate found in Yemen, which is the world's lowest.
What drives these differences in female employment in your part of the world?
